name: releventful
description: Find leads, review conversations, send follow-up replies, and manage lead tasks in Releventful.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Releventful account to find leads, review their details and recent conversations, and take the next step. Send email replies in existing lead conversations, add internal notes, create assigned tasks, save supporting text documents, and update sales stages or event statuses. Uses the connected user's existing account, brand, event and employee permissions. When you connect with the corresponding permissions, actions can send real emails or change records without a second approval screen in Releventful. Your AI application may apply its own tool confirmations. Stage and status changes may run existing automations. Supporting documents are staff-only text files. Invoice creation or editing, BEO changes, reporting, new email conversations, SMS and WhatsApp are not available through this integration. A Releventful account is required.
capabilities: Update sales stages and event statuses
defaultPrompt: Find the lead I want to follow up with.
Show the recent conversations for a lead.
Help me create an assigned follow-up task.

positive.description: Find the existing Sara Smith lead
positive.prompt: In The Willowstone Estate, find and open the lead named Sara Smith's Event, then show its details and scheduled follow-ups.
positive.expected_behavior: Find and open the existing Sara Smith's Event lead in the connected account, return its source link and recorded scheduled work, and distinguish it from other events for the same contact. Do not invent dates, work or messages.

positive.prompt: For Sara Smith's Event in The Willowstone Estate, show the conversation titled Welcome to your event.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the existing email conversation and its recorded messages. The production mirror contained four messages when checked; later review activity may add more.

positive.description: Create a task for the existing owner profile
positive.prompt: For Sara Smith's Event, create a task assigned to John McFuller titled Integration review follow-up, due November 30, 2026, with instructions: Verify the integration review result.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve John McFuller in this account and create one assigned task on the selected lead. This is the existing owner profile for sara@releventful.com. Reuse the same requestId on retries to prevent duplicate tasks.

positive.description: Reply in the existing Sara Smith conversation
positive.prompt: For Sara Smith's Event, send this reply in the existing Welcome to your event email conversation: Releventful integration review test. No action is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Send one real reply in the named existing conversation under the connected user permissions. Recorded participants use sara@releventful.com, sarasmith@releventfulonboarding.com and info@releventful.com. This changes the existing conversation and may email those recipients. Do not select another conversation or send a duplicate retry with a new requestId.

positive.description: Add a note and supporting document to the existing lead
positive.prompt: For Sara Smith's Event, add an internal note saying Integration review completed, and save a staff-only text file named Integration review notes.txt containing the same text.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one internal note and one staff-only supporting text document on the selected existing lead/contact. Do not email the document or share it to the event portal.

negative.prompt: Create an invoice and edit the BEO for this lead.
Show leads belonging to another business or a brand I cannot access.

review.commerce_description: This connector does not process payments or sell goods or services.

publication.release_notes: Initial Releventful MCP connection for lead lookup, existing-conversation follow-ups, assigned tasks, internal notes, staff-only text documents, and sales-stage or event-status updates.
